```{r}

### Global params


# Number of trials per simulation
trials <- 120

# Number of agents to simulate
agents <- 100

# set seed
 set.seed(2001)


```



```{r}

### Win Stay Lose Shift agent -- from Riccardo


agent_wsls <- function(prevChoice, feedback, noise = 0) { ## Implementation of probabilistic version
  # Input validation
  if (!prevChoice %in% c(0, 1)) stop("Previous choice must be 0 or 1.")
  if (!feedback %in% c(0, 1)) stop("Feedback must be 0 or 1.")
  if (!is.numeric(noise) || noise < 0 || noise > 1) stop("Noise must be a probability between 0 and 1.")

  # Core WSLS logic:
  # If feedback is 1 (win), stay: choice = prevChoice
  # If feedback is 0 (loss), shift: choice = 1 - prevChoice
  choice <- ifelse(feedback == 1, prevChoice, 1 - prevChoice)

  # Apply noise if specified
  if (noise > 0 && runif(1) < noise) {
    # Override with a random 50/50 choice
    choice <- sample(c(0, 1), 1)
  }

  return(choice)
}


```




```{r}


### Reinforcement Learning agent (Rescorla-Wagner / delta rule)
# Tracks a belief about the rate at which the opponent plays 'right' (1).
# Updates from the opponent's last observed choice (cf. AdvCogMod codebook ch.3).
# Plays as the non-matcher, so it picks the side it expects the opponent NOT to play.


agent_rl <- function(belief, opponent_prev_choice, alpha = 0.1) {

  # Input validation
  if (!opponent_prev_choice %in% c(0, 1)) stop("Opponent's previous choice must be 0 or 1.")
  if (!is.numeric(alpha) || alpha < 0 || alpha > 1) stop("Alpha must be between 0 and 1.")

  # Update belief about opponent picking 1

  belief <- belief + alpha * (opponent_prev_choice - belief)

  # Non-matcher, so probability of choosing 1 is the chance the opponent picks 0

  choice_prob <- 1 - belief
  choice <- rbinom(1, 1, choice_prob)

  return(list(choice = choice, choice_prob = choice_prob, belief = belief))

}


#### IMPLEMENT EXTRACTION OF CHOICE PROB

```


```{r}

## Setting initial choices
# Both agents pick at random on the first trial
wsls_init <- sample(c(0, 1), 1)

# RL starts with an unbiased belief about the opponent
belief_init <- 0.5

# Setting up vectors for data storage
wsls_choices_vs_rl <- rep(NA, trials)
feedback_vs_rl <- rep(NA, trials)
rl_choices_vs_wsls <- rep(NA, trials)
choice_probs_rl <- rep(NA, trials)
beliefs_rl <- rep(NA, trials)

## Insert first choices
wsls_choices_vs_rl[1] <- wsls_init
beliefs_rl[1] <- belief_init
choice_probs_rl[1] <- 1 - belief_init
rl_choices_vs_wsls[1] <- rbinom(1, 1, choice_probs_rl[1])

## Setup game loop
for (t in 2:trials) {

  ## Compute previous trial outcome (matcher wins on a match)
  prev_feedback_wsls <- ifelse(wsls_choices_vs_rl[t - 1] == rl_choices_vs_wsls[t - 1], 1, 0)
  feedback_vs_rl[t - 1] <- prev_feedback_wsls

  ## WSLS updating based on its own previous outcome
  wsls_choices_vs_rl[t] <- agent_wsls(wsls_choices_vs_rl[t-1],
                                      prev_feedback_wsls,
                                      noise = 0.25)

  ## RL updating from the opponent's previous choice
  rl_step <- agent_rl(beliefs_rl[t-1],
                      wsls_choices_vs_rl[t-1],
                      alpha = 0.1) ## LEARNING RATE TWEAK THIS

  rl_choices_vs_wsls[t] <- rl_step$choice
  choice_probs_rl[t] <- rl_step$choice_prob
  beliefs_rl[t] <- rl_step$belief
}

# fill in last-trial feedback so the column isn't NA at the end
feedback_vs_rl[trials] <- ifelse(wsls_choices_vs_rl[trials] == rl_choices_vs_wsls[trials], 1, 0)

#  dataframe creation
df_vs_rl <- tibble(
  trial = 1:trials,
  Self_WSLS = wsls_choices_vs_rl,
  Opponent_RL = rl_choices_vs_wsls,
  Feedback_WSLS = feedback_vs_rl,
  Choice_Prob_RL = choice_probs_rl,
  Belief_RL = beliefs_rl
) %>% mutate(
  Cumulative_Performance = cumsum(Feedback_WSLS) / row_number()
)

## Viz
p_choices_wsls <- ggplot(df_vs_rl, aes(x = trial)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Self_WSLS, color = "WSLS Agent")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Opponent_RL + 0.05, color = "RL Agent"), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "WSLS vs. RL (0.1 LR)", y = "Choice (0/1)") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  ylim(-0.1, 1.1)

p_perf_wsls <- ggplot(df_vs_rl, aes(x = trial, y = Cumulative_Performance)) +
  geom_line(color = "purple", size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "WSLS Performance vs. RL (0.1 LR)", y = "Proportion Wins") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  ylim(0, 1)


library(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(p_choices_wsls, p_perf_wsls, nrow = 2)

# Plot choice probabilities
p_choice_prob <- ggplot(df_vs_rl, aes(x = trial, y = Choice_Prob_RL)) +  # FIX 4: Use the column name
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "RL Agent Choice Probability of Choosing 1 (0.1 LR)",
       y = "Choice Probability") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  ylim(0, 1)

p_choice_prob

```
